meanings.note: common in TV/radio programming and magazines

examples.trans: There is a special broadcast tonight.
I watched the Lunar New Year special program.

meanings.note: a large island off the southern coast of South Korea

examples.trans: I want to go to Geoje Island in the summer.
The sea at Geoje Island is really pretty.
I am going to Busan tomorrow.

meanings.note: 어딜 is a colloquial contraction of 어디를

examples.trans: Where are you going on the weekend?

meanings.note: casual first-person singular pronoun; polite equivalent is 저

examples.trans: I want to go together too.

meanings.note: placed before a verb to express inability or impossibility

examples.trans: I can't go today because I don't have time.
I can't eat spicy food well.

meanings.en: far, far away, in the distance

examples.trans: A friend came from far away.

그렇다.gloss: to be so, to do so

meanings.en: to be like that, to be so
meanings.note: ㅎ-irregular; also used as a pro-verb ('do so / say so')

examples.trans: I bought bread. And I bought milk too.
The weather was nice, so we ate outdoors.
There is a lot of outdoor filming.

meanings.en: going to bed, sleeping for the night
meanings.note: 야외 취침 (sleeping outdoors) is a classic Korean variety-show trope
contracts to 이게 in speech when combined with subject particle -이

examples.trans: That drama has high viewer ratings.
The ratings went up a lot.

meanings.en: to be produced, result (e.g. ratings, results)

examples.trans: The exam results come out tomorrow.
Please come outside for a moment.

meanings.note: bound noun; often contracts to 거 in spoken Korean

meanings.en: to not do, refrain from (used in -지 말다 negative imperatives)
to be cold (weather or feeling cold)

examples.trans: The weather is really cold today.
Please close the window, it's cold.

meanings.en: to be dying of (hyperbolic emphasis in -아/어 죽겠다)

examples.trans: It's so hot I feel like I'm going to die.

meanings.en: actually, in fact, to tell the truth
meanings.note: adverbial use of the noun 사실 (fact)

examples.trans: Honestly, I don't know well either.
In fact, I couldn't sleep yesterday.
My stamina is completely at rock bottom.
The company fell into a big crisis.
Let's meet next time (at the next opportunity).
Please don't say it like that.
It's not that difficult compared to what I thought.
I'm always anxious before an exam.
I feel a bit uneasy when I'm alone.

meanings.en: to not (used after -지 to negate verbs and adjectives)
